registration.nearArm: anatomical right holding one fan of five red-gold fire talismans
registration.farArm: anatomical left holding one brass bell with red tassel

frames.pose: First contact: knees begin flexing, torso recoils 4 degrees right, right fan starts inward toward chest, left bell stays near far ribs.
Compression: knees deepen, torso recoils 11 degrees, chin tucks, right fan diagonally guards chest, far left bell comes up to sternum.
Peak recoil 19 degrees toward right, knees flexed, wince, both props guarded; fan near and bell far; feet anchored.
Rebound: torso returns to 12 degrees, knees begin extending, right fan lowers a little, left bell drops from sternum; ponytail now trails right.
Recovery: torso only 4 degrees back, eyes reopening, fan resumes guard at lower chest, bell near far waist.
Alert settle: upright facing left, knees gently flexed, fan forward at chest, bell lower far side, ribbon finishes settling.
Ready: facing left, slight knee bend, open five-card fan in near right hand ahead of chest; bell far left hand low at waist.
Gather: right fingers draw fan cards together, elbow pulls rightward close to flank; shoulders rotate back slightly, bell held stable.
Full windup: fan tightly gathered in near right hand at chest-right, torso turns slightly toward camera and right shoulder loads; knees compressed.
Acceleration: right elbow begins straightening toward screen-left, tightly gathered talisman fan passes centerline; left bell remains tucked far side.
Contact: near right arm forcefully thrusts/sweeps compact closed talisman fan toward screen-left at chest level, torso leans left 9 degrees; no particles.
Peak extension: right elbow nearly extended, fan tip a little lower and further left, forward shoulder rotates through while grounded feet stay fixed.
Follow-through: fan wrist crosses slightly downward and left, right shoulder comes forward, torso begins damping; bell tassel trails.
First recovery: right elbow folds fan inward toward front waist; head lifts a little and torso straightens.
Recoil recovery: gathered fan comes back to near chest, right wrist rotates upright; far bell returns to low waist.
Reopening: five talisman cards start to spread, forearm rises to guard, knees extend to ready bend.
Near settle: fan almost fully open, right elbow relaxed, ponytail and robe settling after forward stroke.
Alert ready finish: fan fully open at chest, bell low far side, leftward gaze focused; distinct small breathing settle from frame11.
